Resolves #19989

Retires pre-detached tab buttons in `Neo.dashboard.dock.projection.Reconciler#reconcileTabChrome` before positional length-pairing when a concurrent cross-window transfer claims a departing pane into the receiving popup vessel before the surviving source strip reconciles, flushes silent bar removals on retained strips, and destroys residual `dock-vessel-placeholder` stand-ins even when `preserveItemIds` holds the transferred item. Detailed trace: #19989 intake comment [QUARANTINED_URL: github.com]

Evidence: L3 (headless Chromium: CI's `e2e-brain` tier runs `WorkstationTransferIntoVesselHeaderNL.spec.mjs` at head; red on `dev` verified locally) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-2, AC-3, AC-4).

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationTransferIntoVesselHeaderNL.spec.mjs` (`e2e-brain`) and `test/playwright/unit/dashboard/DockProjectionReconciler.spec.mjs`. |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `WorkstationTransferIntoVesselHeaderNL.spec.mjs` asserts zero `Dock projection failed` warnings. |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: `WorkstationTransferIntoVesselHeaderNL.spec.mjs` asserts `workstation-vessel:logs` holds `['logs', 'metrics']` with active `'metrics'` and 2 rendered tab headers. |
| AC-4 | CI-covered at head (`e2e-brain` via `buildScripts/util/e2eCiSelection.mjs`); red-on-`dev` receipt in `## Test Evidence`. |
| AC-5 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/dashboard/DockProjectionReconciler.spec.mjs` (44/44 passing, including the existing untrusted-pairing exactness guards). |

None substantive.

- **Red on `dev` (`8abdcf978c`, `WorkstationTransferIntoVesselHeaderNL.spec.mjs`, `--repeat-each=4`):** Fails 4/4 (`11.6s` per run) at `await expect(headerButtons, 'only the Audit tab header remains in right-top-tabs').toHaveCount(1)` (`Locator: locator('#neo-tab-container-4 .neo-tab-header-button')`, `Expected: 1`, `Received: 2`), with two App-Worker console warnings on the Neural Link bridge (`Dock projection failed (retired-staged)` and `the repair attempt failed too: Dock projection tab chrome "right-top-tabs" has an inexact item set`).
- **Green at head (`742653acee`, `--repeat-each=4`):** `WorkstationTransferIntoVesselHeaderNL.spec.mjs` passes 4/4 (`52.0s`); `DockProjectionReconciler.spec.mjs` passes 44/44 (`2.0s`).
